name: Algebraic Subspace Isomorphism
description: Maps the graph connectivity problem to an isomorphic problem of linear algebraic entailment. By presenting edges as equations $x_u - x_v = 0$ and connectivity as subspace restriction, models are deprived of graph-theoretic keywords and must deduce from first principles that the minimal subspace restriction over $m = n - 1$ independent variables forms a tree structure.
